P7538's Operator/Owner should reflect Gazprom Dobycha Krasnodar (not Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta) from mid-2014 onward if the row's status covers the current period -- this is a DIFFERENT operator than P5540/String II, which this session confirmed remained with Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta. Also: nangs.org (2021-05-24) and a Jan-2020 Gazprom Dobycha Krasnodar press release (https://web.archive.org/web/20221126125224/https://krasnodar-dobycha.gazprom.ru/press/news/2020/01/568/) both document post-2014 String-I-specific capital repairs (2020: km 68-175; 2021: km 68-124) run by Gazprom Dobycha Krasnodar's LPUMT -- useful direct evidence for P7538's own Status/Operator fills.

This 2021-05-24 nangs.org article's own 'Справка' (fact box) states String I ('Вуктыл — Ухта I нитка') was commissioned ('введен в эксплуатацию') in 1968, diameter 1020mm -- CONFLICTS with a Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta corporate-history chronicle (Severgazprom newspaper) which instead states industrial operation of 'Вуктыл – Ухта I' began in 1969 ('Началась промышленная эксплуатация газопровода «Вуктыл – Ухта I»' under the 1969 heading, with 1968 reserved for the Vuktyl gas FIELD's own trial production start). Whoever researches P7538's Start year should reconcile this 1968-vs-1969 discrepancy rather than assume either source is automatically correct.

Vuktylskoye LPUMG's own March-2023 corporate feature states the branch's very first trunk pipelines used pipe of 'диаметром 1220 и 1420 мм' (1220mm and 1420mm) -- NOT 1020mm. This is circumstantial but worth checking against P7538's own 1020mm figure: 1020mm may be a later/different-generation pipe than the branch's earliest (1220/1420mm) construction, or the two co-located Punga-Vuktyl-Ukhta transit lines (1420mm-class, typical of West Siberian long-haul mains) may be what's meant by the 1420mm figure while 1220mm maps to Vuktyl-Ukhta II (P5540, this row) -- leaving 1020mm/String I's relationship to this specific sentence unclear. Worth a second look when researching P7538's Diameter.
